summary: Bull Smith's daughter (John's 9th-great-grand-aunt); married William Lawrence of Flushing, Gov. Philip Carteret of New Jersey and Col. Richard Townley.
bio: Her first husband William Lawrence came on the Planter in 1635 with his stepfather John Tuttell; his estate was £2,021, his sword, plate and personal effects appraised separately at a high figure. Her prenuptial agreement with Gov. Carteret (1681) kept Tew's Neck for her Lawrence sons; she had no Carteret children. Col. Townley came over with Virginia Gov. Lord Howard of Effingham in 1683. Carteret and Townley are in-laws only. Ancestress of the Flushing Lawrence cousins.
sources: Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858), https://archive.org/details/historicalgeneal00lawr
